g.text: ops schema: jobs, job logs and dbt results

text.tspan: The API inserts queued jobs only; the worker alone moves status to running, succeeded or failed.
ux_job_single_active (unique on (1) where status is queued or running) allows one active job: a second POST answers 409.
job.run_id references ops.load_run (load runs diagram); job_log keeps at most 5,000 lines per job; dbt_invocation and dbt_node_result are copied from run_results.json.
